# owner: platform
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: list) -> str:
    """Build a short parent notice listing the student's absent days in order."""
    if any(mark.student_id != student.student_id for mark in marks):
        raise ValueError("marks include another student")
    days = sorted(mark.day for mark in marks if mark.status == "absent")
    if not days:
        raise ValueError("no absences to report")
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    return f"{name} missed {len(days)} day(s) of school: {dates}."
# end of file
EOF
cat > tests/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.attendance import parse_day
from rosterkit.models import Mark


STUDENT = Student("1001", "Thistle", "Bram", "A")


def mark(student_id, text, status):
    return Mark(student_id, parse_day(text), status)


class AbsenceNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        """Only absent days appear, sorted, with the count."""
        marks = [
            mark("1001", "2026-09-04", "absent"),
            mark("1001", "2026-09-02", "late"),
            mark("1001", "2026-09-03", "absent")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks),
            "Bram Thistle missed 2 day(s) of school: 2026-09-03, 2026-09-04."
        )

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        """A mark for a different student raises."""
        marks = [mark("1002", "2026-09-03", "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        """No absent marks raises."""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, [mark("1001", "2026-09-03", "present")])
# end of file
EOF
